body:
I was on a strange kick of IVing random shit (Ativan, Ambien, Wellbutrin, E-Cig Juice etc) and so when I thought of how the chemical Capsaicin is the chemical that makes peppers spicy and also has been shown to have slight intoxicating effects (similar to cigarette buzz) albeit not very strong ones.
I saw some pepper spray in my girlfriends purse and decided to give it a go, after getting roaring-drunk and the cultivation of much testicular-fortitude. I put some of it in a spoon and drew it through some cotton, filling my syringe with 4 (maybe 5) units of the shit. I was curious to see what effects it might have had.
As soon as I pricked myself with the needle I felt intense burning. I knew I still had the option of turning back, but I chose to ignore it and proceed with the principle of knowledge in mind. I drew blood and pressed it into the vein with a steady precision. The INTENSELY INEXPLICABLE BURNING was instant and strong and flowed with the blood throughout my body: I could literally make a map of my circulatory system with the pain. Every cell in my body becametheres really no way of describing it. The pain was far more intense than any pepper Id ever encountered in my lifetime. I thought about injecting milk, but figured it wouldnt work.
I was very sweaty and the inside of my nostrils burned and flared and released every inch of my sinuses contents all over my face. My mouth burned too of course and I could smell and taste a spice too spicy to taste like peppers. The burning began to numb my limbs and suddenly my vision was gone! A whiteout ensued along with a whistling sound similar to a very silent cocaine-induced ringer. I remember trying to control the burn by breathing through my mouth and not my nose. It helped, but not enough to notice anything really. I guess you could say it didnt help but I feel like it did on some level. When my vision came back after about twenty seconds I couldnt move my neck to look up, and there was no such thing as down. The vision to my left and right was warped by narrow tunnel vision and I had no idea what mental place I was in, all I knew was that I didnt think I wanted to be back in it after this time.
I had tunnel hearing too. The distortion was noted by the sound my girlfriends voice made as she walked back into the room and was saying something to me too distorted for me to understand. I was ready to try shooting up a CC of milk, but when I stood I just rolled off the couch and fell and found myself unable to stand. My girlfriend was alarmed by this, as she knew me to be an IV user and thought by the deathly look about me that I might have shot too much cocaine. When I vomited she thought she knew that her supposition was true.
After about an hour of harrow and no avail brought by the milk, I finally was able to explain to her what I did and she laughed loudly at my stupidity. I knew it wasnt a good idea, but I was curious. I couldnt walk for an entire day because the burning was so strong and painful that it numbed and seemed to singe my nerves and I couldnt put any weight on any of them. I couldnt grip anything either and I chalk it up to shock. She had to help me do anything for an entire 20 hours. I my urine and stool burned too and I couldnt taste anything for nearly a day either.
All in all, it was worth the experiment, but not something I nor you should ever wish to repeat. I dont think this will ever need to be read because I have doubts that anyone is bravely-stupid enough to attempt such a feat.
